capabilities: Sync finished BrainPost notes into the vault's Inbox folder
Verify an Identity Token and connect the vault to a BrainPost project
Download and verify binary attachments and link them relatively
Acknowledge sync events to prevent duplicate delivery
Preserve or trash status notes depending on local edits
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); does not support mobile. Any BrainPost service plans are billed on brainpost.me, not through the plugin. Includes a detailed data/network-use and privacy section; troubleshooting covers conflicts, verification failures, and connectivity.
problem: Notes captured through the BrainPost web and mobile apps have to be moved into an Obsidian vault by hand; this plugin delivers them automatically.

relations.evidence: BrainPost automatically syncs finished notes from brainpost.me into the Inbox/ folder of your local Obsidian vault.

summary: Syncs finished notes captured in BrainPost into an Inbox folder of the local vault, including verified attachments.
